Is exposed to excessive noise: Yes

2 - 4 Years of related experience

STORES OPERATIONS - Responsible for issuing, laundering, repairing, and maintaining athletic uniforms, apparel, footwear, and equipment. Operate laundry equipment to maintain uniforms, apparel, and towels in clean and sanitary condition. Wash, fold, shelve, and inventory items in an organized and rapid manner. Responsible for locker rooms and team rooms. Assign locks & lockers, issue towels and equipment to student-athletes, and staff. (40% time)

Customer Service - Maintain and develop good customer relations and service with the campus community. Maintain and develop communication, cooperation and service between the Equipment room and coaches and staff. Handle complaints and concerns in a positive and professional manner. Notify manager of customer criticism, complaints, and suggestions for improvement. (15% time)

Inventory - Maintain inventory controls via designated equipment software. Operate within an atmosphere of compliance and integrity, and within the scope and intent of NCAA, Big West Conference, and university regulations. Compliance-related activities and paperwork must be accomplished and/or submitted in a complete and timely manner. Maintain current, accurate and organized records and files (computerized and physical) for operation activity on annual and historical basis. (15% time)

Place orders. Monitor all orders; obtain return authorizations for defective or incorrect-sized items. Maintain paperwork and files. Receive and inspect all incoming shipments. Accurately account for all cartons in shipment. Unpack and verify items against the PO. Inspect items for quality and condition. Inventory, label and shelve items. Deliver to appropriate Athletic personnel. (15% time)

Facility, Equipment, and Special Events - Perform assignments as needed for Athletic contests and events such as games, track meets, departmental special events (such as golf tournaments and banquets), and facility rentals. Assist in game management duties to include: setting up locker rooms; moving equipment, uniforms, and towels to and from venue; Monitor and maintain fields, courts and team benches. Assist Game Manager with oversight of ball persons at volleyball and basketball games. Responsible for the accurate measurement and lining of Softball field to conform to NCAA Division I requirements. Clean and maintain equipment room and laundry room. Assist with facility related needs as requested, including submittal of Facilites Services request tickets. (10% time)
Other duties as assigned (5% time)
